title: Proposed payment run for the next seven days
prompt: Prepare a proposed payment run for the next seven days, considering due dates, available cash, approvals and duplicate payment risk.

setup.q: What are the payment rules (pay on due date, take discounts, hold unapproved bills, pay by ACH unless the vendor requires check)?
What cash balance must remain after the run?
Which vendors are paid first when cash is short (payroll providers, landlords, critical suppliers)?

inputs.name: Open bills with approval status and due dates

steps: pull open bills with due dates and approval status, bank balances and the last 90 days of payments
select the bills due within seven days under paymentRules; apply vendorPriority when the total exceeds cash less minimumCash
run duplicate_pairs over the selected bills and the recent payments: same vendor and amount, close dates
list separately every vendor whose bank details changed since their last payment
write the proposed run and the exceptions; no payment is initiated and no bill is changed

done.text: Every exception row (a possible duplicate, an unapproved bill, a beneficiary change) cites the bill id and the matching payment id where one exists
proposed-payment-run.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The proposed run total equals open bills due within seven days on Dime's AP aging less the holds listed

This is a recommendation only: no payment is initiated, no bill is approved or changed; vendors whose bank details changed are listed separately for a person to confirm by phone; cash after the run is shown against the minimum
